en: A black‑and‑white view of a large Renaissance‑style manor or small castle partly hidden behind tall conifer trees. The building has steeply pitched tiled roofs with ornate gabled dormers featuring scrollwork and circular windows. A tower with a bulbous dome and cross rises in the background to the right. The photo has a wide black border, and faint handwritten text appears inverted along the lower edge.
